title: Saro's Player Plushie Recipe
description: A datapack to add a crafting recipe for Saro's Player Plushies Lite
body:
A quick datapack I made to add a crafting recipe for the plushie in **[Saro's Player Plushie Lite](https://modrinth.com/mod/saros-player-plushie-lite)**. The recipe for the plushie is shapeless and consists of 1 armor stand and 1 of any wool.

This was made for Minecraft 1.21.1, but should work with any Minecraft version 1.21.x. I have not checked to see if this is compatible with the full version of **Saro's Player Plushie**, but I plan on expanding the compatability in the future. So look out for updates compatible with the full version, 26.1, and future Minecraft or mod updates.

_I am in no way affiliated with [Sarocesch](https://modrinth.com/user/Sarocesch). I made this datapack on my own to make the version of their mod that I downloaded survival friendly._
